priorities: Evaluate loLevel >= hiLevel first: set error to TRUE and status to 16#8001.
Otherwise, if hystWindow >= real32(hiLevel - loLevel), set error to TRUE and status to 16#8002.
On either invalid configuration, preserve both alarm states. Skip alarm evaluation, but complete the timer and output stages.
On valid configuration, clear error and status and evaluate the two alarm machines independently. Strict comparisons preserve the corresponding alarm at either hysteresis boundary.

Assume nonnegative hystWindow and finite inputs and intermediate results. Use IEEE 754 binary32 rounding to nearest, ties to even, for the span and release thresholds; negative hystWindow is outside the defined domain.

initial_values.inputs: Externally supplied; no initial input values specified.

scan_execution_order.name: Edge sampling
scan_execution_order.action: Snapshot Value, hiLevel, loLevel and hystWindow once for the scan. No edge detectors are required.

scan_execution_order.name: Safety/reset priority and state transitions
scan_execution_order.action: Apply the configuration checks in priority order and set diagError and diagStatus every scan. On invalid configuration, retain qHi and qLo. Otherwise set diagError to FALSE and diagStatus to 16#0000, then update qHi and qLo independently using the state-machine transitions. There is no reset input.

scan_execution_order.name: Unconditional top-level timer FB calls outside CASE/IF
scan_execution_order.action: No timer FBs are required; this stage contains no calls.

scan_execution_order.name: Unified output assignments
scan_execution_order.action: Assign hiAlarm := qHi, loAlarm := qLo, error := diagError, and status := diagStatus.

formal_assertions.formula: G(((loLevel < hiLevel) & (hystWindow >= 0.0) & (hystWindow < real32(hiLevel - loLevel)) & (Value > hiLevel)) -> hiAlarm)
G(((loLevel < hiLevel) & (hystWindow >= 0.0) & (hystWindow < real32(hiLevel - loLevel)) & (Value < real32(hiLevel - hystWindow))) -> !hiAlarm)
G(((loLevel < hiLevel) & (hystWindow >= 0.0) & (hystWindow < real32(hiLevel - loLevel)) & (Value < loLevel)) -> loAlarm)
G(((loLevel < hiLevel) & (hystWindow >= 0.0) & (hystWindow < real32(hiLevel - loLevel)) & (Value > real32(loLevel + hystWindow))) -> !loAlarm)
